title: Independent F-MR30 Accepted Root-Uptake Attribution Receipt Qualification

positive_control.description: candidate physically advanced with forcing A and attribution prepared from the same forcing A
positive_control.meaning: generic transaction mass accounting and the correctly paired attribution path are sound in this controlled oracle

hard_negative.setup: create physical candidate with forcing A; call public attribution prepare on the same ready candidate using different individually valid forcing B; commit the original A candidate through the real generic accepted-commit receipt; finalize B-prepared attribution against that valid commit receipt
hard_negative.scientific_effect: process attribution provenance can be wrong while the generic physical transaction and hard water-balance ledger remain correct

root_cause.candidate_contract: kernel_candidate_state_t binds state, lineage, origin revision, interval and generic mass accounting but carries no identity for the physical forcing used to create it
root_cause.fmr30_prepare_contract: fmr_prepare_root_uptake_attribution accepts forcing and candidate as independent public arguments and derives the amount from the supplied forcing
root_cause.commit_receipt_contract: fmr_accepted_commit_receipt_t authenticates accepted candidate lineage/revision/interval but cannot authenticate which qrot vector generated the candidate
root_cause.caller_discipline_dependency: the candidate therefore relies silently on the caller to pair the exact original qrot forcing with the candidate

mass_disposition.warning: do not classify this finding as a generic mass-conservation failure

remaining_matrix.reason: frozen early-exit rule: a reproduced fail-open hard negative is sufficient to deny independent admission and further cases cannot reverse that decision

recommended_remediation.principle: bind attribution preparation to the exact forcing object used for physical candidate creation by construction, without adding root uptake to the generic mass ledger
recommended_remediation.preferred_minimal_route: trusted runtime/orchestration wrapper receives forcing once, invokes kernel advance and creates the nonpublishing prepared attribution from that exact same forcing/candidate pair; raw arbitrary forcing-plus-candidate preparation should not remain a public misuse surface
recommended_remediation.generic_kernel_forcing_fingerprint: not recommended unless a later general attribution architecture demonstrates reusable need
